findings.current: He had walked straight into a trap laid by the Peace Guild.
findings.defect: The draft makes Park Jihoon himself physically walk into the trap, but the context indicates that Myeongdong Guild’s dispatched personnel were caught in it.
findings.rationale: The following sentences infer what happened to Manager Kim, while Jihoon remains in the limousine; the trapped party is the dispatched Myeongdong personnel, not Jihoon.
findings.replacement: Myeongdong Guild’s people had fallen neatly into a trap laid by the Peace Guild.
findings.source: 평화 길드가 파놓은 함정에 보기 좋게 걸려든 것이다.

findings.current: “Team 11’s condition is still unknown, and a celebrity currently making the biggest headlines in the country has barged into Myeongdong Guild headquarters. You’re saying that isn’t serious?”
findings.defect: “Condition is still unknown” omits the explicit possibility that Team 11 may be dead.
findings.rationale: 생사 means life or death, making Park Tae Seop’s concern substantially more serious than uncertainty about the team’s general condition.
findings.replacement: “We don’t even know whether Team 11 is alive or dead, and the public figure currently drawing more attention than anyone else in the country has barged into Myeongdong Guild headquarters. You’re saying that isn’t serious?”
findings.source: 11팀은 아직 생사도 파악하지 못했고, 현재 국내 최고의 화제를 모으고 있는 유명 인사가 명동 길드 본사에 쳐들어왔는데 심각한 일이 아니다?

findings.current: Because their identities had been scrubbed so thoroughly, every Black Hunter, including Im Yeongjun, had already undergone an identity change.
findings.defect: The draft redundantly describes both scrubbing and an “identity change,” which suggests a literal transformation rather than the deliberate laundering of official identities and records.
findings.rationale: 신분 세탁 refers to laundering or sanitizing a person’s identity to conceal links, which directly explains the absence of any connection to Myeongdong Guild in the next sentence.
findings.replacement: They had been managed so meticulously that every Black Hunter, including Im Yeongjun, had already undergone identity laundering.
findings.source: 치밀하게 관리한 탓에 임영준을 포함한 블랙 헌터 전원은 이미 전부 신분 세탁을 거쳤다.

findings.current: The other Myeongdong Guild Hunters who came running after the fact also failed to attack me when they saw the scene before them.
findings.defect: “Failed to attack” can imply an unsuccessful attempt, whereas the source says they did not dare attack at all.
findings.rationale: 감히 … 못했다 explicitly conveys intimidation and unwillingness to challenge Taekyung, not failure after taking action.
findings.replacement: The other Myeongdong Guild Hunters who arrived later didn’t dare attack me after seeing the scene before them.
findings.source: 뒤늦게 달려온 명동 길드의 다른 헌터들도 눈 앞에 펼쳐진 광경에 감히 내게 덤벼들지 못했다.

findings.current: Park Tae Seop handed him his phone. A vein stood out sharply on his forehead.
findings.defect: This says the transfer is already complete, conflicting with the subsequent action in which Park Jihoon only takes the phone after being ordered to hurry.
findings.rationale: The paired actions 건넸다 and 건네받아 indicate that Park Tae Seop first offers the phone and Park Jihoon then accepts it.
findings.replacement: Park Tae Seop held out his phone to him. A vein stood out sharply on his forehead.
findings.source: 박태섭이 자신의 핸드폰을 그에게 건넸다. 이마 위로 핏줄이 불끈 도드라져 보였다.

findings.current: “I heard he was stupid and greedy, and that he disguised his lack of skill behind his fame.”
findings.defect: The draft adds the claim that Won actively concealed a total lack of skill; the source says his fame was used to make his abilities look better than they were.
findings.rationale: 실력도 유명세로 포장한 describes ability embellished or packaged through fame, without explicitly saying that he had no skill or deliberately hid that fact.
findings.replacement: “I heard he was stupid and greedy, and that his fame made him look more skilled than he really was.”
findings.source: 멍청하고, 탐욕스러운 것으로도 모자라 실력도 유명세로 포장한 놈이었다는 이야기는 들었지.

findings.rationale: 씨발 is direct, strong profanity, and the terse internal outburst should retain that force.

findings.current: Kim Butler’s role as an excellent mage and wise adviser probably helped, but at this point, I had to assume it was something he was born with.
findings.defect: The established title and name are reversed, producing an unnatural and inconsistent form.
findings.rationale: 김 집사 is the established “Butler Kim,” and naming Choi in the second clause removes an avoidable ambiguous pronoun without adding information.
findings.replacement: Butler Kim’s role as an excellent mage and wise adviser probably helped, but at this point, I had to assume Choi was simply born that way.
findings.source: 뛰어난 마법사이자 현명한 조언자인 김 집사의 역할도 있겠지만, 이 정도면 타고났다고 봐야 한다.

findings.current: Maybe it was because it was an AdultPhone, but even a picture taken with a foot came out great.
findings.defect: The unexplained literal “AdultPhone” does not convey the Korean iPhone wordplay to an English reader.
findings.rationale: 어른폰 replaces the 아이 in 아이폰 with its opposite, 어른; the footnote preserves the deliberately altered brand name and makes the joke intelligible.
findings.replacement:
Maybe it was because it was an AdultPhone,[^2] but even a picture taken with a foot came out great.

[^2]: “AdultPhone” is a Korean pun on iPhone: *ai* can mean “child,” while *eoreun* means “adult.”
findings.source: 역시 어른폰이라 그런가, 발로 찍어도 잘 나오더라.

summary: The draft contains one changed action subject, several losses of explicit stakes or intimidation, and localized terminology and register issues.
